compiled_state.title: UPDATE: Add push-before-dispatch to fix-bug and debug-everything callers
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE

Gap identified by gap analysis: fix-bug/SKILL.md and debug-everything/SKILL.md also dispatch sub-agents via worktree-dispatch.md but do NOT have the push-before-dispatch step added by T4 for sprint. Without this, sub-agents dispatched from fix-bug or debug-everything in a session worktree will still see stale main HEAD.

## Acceptance Criteria

**plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md:**
- Before the first sub-agent dispatch (Phase C, investigation dispatch), when IS_SESSION_WORKTREE=true, add:
  ```
  # Push session branch so sub-agent worktrees can fetch session commits
  git push -u origin HEAD
  ```
- Only push once per skill invocation (not before every sub-agent); idempotent if already pushed

**plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md:**
- Before the first sub-agent dispatch (Phase B or C), when IS_SESSION_WORKTREE=true, add the same push step
- Only push once per skill invocation

**Structural tests:**
- Create or extend a test asserting git push -u origin HEAD appears in fix-bug/SKILL.md before the investigation dispatch
- Create or extend a test asserting git push -u origin HEAD appears in debug-everything/SKILL.md before first dispatch

## File Impact

### Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md
- plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md

### Files to Create (or extend)
- tests/hooks/test-fixbug-skill-push-before-dispatch.sh
- tests/hooks/test-debug-skill-push-before-dispatch.sh

## Done Definitions

- [ ] fix-bug/SKILL.md has push-before-dispatch in Phase C (before investigation sub-agent)
- [ ] debug-everything/SKILL.md has push-before-dispatch before first sub-agent dispatch
- [ ] Both pushes are conditional on IS_SESSION_WORKTREE=true (or clearly scoped with a comment)
- [ ] Structural test for fix-bug passes
- [ ] Structural test for debug-everything passes
- [ ] No existing structural tests broken

## Retry Budget

Max 2 retry attempts.
